rows.label: MUSIC
rows.clue: An artistic form of auditory communication incorporating instrumental or vocal tones in a structured and continuous manner

rows.label: SIXTEENTH NOTE
rows.clue: A musical note having the time value of a sixteenth of a whole note

rows.label: REEXAMINATION
rows.clue: (law) questioning of a witness by the party that called the witness after that witness has been subject to cross-examination

rows.label: REPROACH
rows.clue: A mild rebuke or criticism

rows.label: AGENDA ITEM
rows.clue: One of the items to be considered

rows.label: CALL MARK
rows.clue: A mark consisting of characters written on a book

rows.label: DIACRITIC
rows.clue: A mark added to a letter to indicate a special pronunciation

rows.label: ORATION
rows.clue: An instance of oratory

rows.label: SPEECH SOUND
rows.clue: (phonetics) an individual sound unit of speech without concern as to whether or not it is a phoneme of some language

rows.label: EXHIBITIONISM
rows.clue: Extravagant and conspicuous behavior intended to attract attention to yourself

rows.label: WINNING POST
rows.clue: The post at the end of a racecourse

rows.label: REWRITE
rows.clue: Something that has been written again

rows.label: TRIBUTE
rows.clue: Something given or done as an expression of esteem

rows.label: STUDYING
rows.clue: Reading carefully with intent to remember

rows.label: THANK YOU
rows.clue: A conversational expression of gratitude

rows.label: HIGH SIGN
rows.clue: A silent signal of warning or recognition

rows.label: WRITING SYSTEM
rows.clue: A method of representing the sounds of a language by written or printed symbols

rows.label: SOCIAL POLICY
rows.clue: A policy of for dealing with social issues

rows.label: FROWN
rows.clue: A facial expression of dislike or displeasure

rows.label: CARD CATALOG
rows.clue: A library catalog in which each publication is described on a separate file card

rows.label: TRAIN TICKET
rows.clue: A ticket good for a ride on a railroad train

rows.label: PROLOGUE
rows.clue: An introduction to a play

rows.label: FREE VERSE
rows.clue: Unrhymed verse without a consistent metrical pattern

rows.label: DUPLICITY
rows.clue: A fraudulent or duplicitous representation

rows.label: FARM BILL
rows.clue: A statute that would regulate farm production and prices

rows.label: MAGAZINE
rows.clue: A periodic publication containing pictures and stories and articles of interest to those who purchase it or subscribe to it

rows.label: RUNNING TITLE
rows.clue: The title (or a shortened title) of a book used as a running head

rows.label: INTRANSITIVE
rows.clue: A verb (or verb construction) that does not take an object

rows.label: ASSASSINATION
rows.clue: An attack intended to ruin someone's reputation

rows.label: FIGURED BASS
rows.clue: A bass part written out in full and accompanied by numbers to indicate the chords to be played

rows.label: GLASNOST
rows.clue: A policy of the Soviet government allowing freer discussion of social problems

rows.label: ASSERTION
rows.clue: A declaration that is made emphatically (as if no supporting evidence were necessary)

rows.label: TRUMPERY
rows.clue: Nonsensical talk or writing

rows.label: EQUAL SIGN
rows.clue: A sign indicating that the quantities on either side are equal

rows.label: LEITMOTIF
rows.clue: A melodic phrase that accompanies the reappearance of a person or situation (as in Wagner's operas)

rows.label: IMPUDENCE
rows.clue: An impudent statement

rows.label: PROFILE
rows.clue: An analysis (often in graphical form) representing the extent to which something exhibits various characteristics

rows.label: PREVIEW
rows.clue: An advertisement consisting of short scenes from a motion picture that will appear in the near future

rows.label: PROLIXITY
rows.clue: Boring verbosity

rows.label: GUFFAW
rows.clue: A burst of deep loud hearty laughter

rows.label: DEGREE PROGRAM
rows.clue: A course of study leading to an academic degree

rows.label: BRAGGADOCIO
rows.clue: Vain and empty boasting

rows.label: SKULL SESSION
rows.clue: A session (as of executives or advisors) to discuss policy or strategy or to solve problems or exchange ideas

rows.label: MUSICAL
rows.clue: A play or film whose action and dialogue is interspersed with singing and dancing

rows.label: EPSILON
rows.clue: The 5th letter of the Greek alphabet

rows.label: ABSURDITY
rows.clue: A message whose content is at variance with reason

rows.label: WORDBOOK
rows.clue: A reference book containing words (usually with their meanings)

rows.label: MAJOR PREMISE
rows.clue: The premise of a syllogism that contains the major term (which is the predicate of the conclusion)

rows.label: COUNT NOUN
rows.clue: A noun that forms plurals

rows.label: PARAPHRASE
rows.clue: Rewording for the purpose of clarification

rows.label: MIDDLE TERM
rows.clue: The term in a syllogism that is common to both premises and excluded from the conclusion

rows.label: MINOR TERM
rows.clue: The term in a syllogism that is the subject of the conclusion

rows.label: FALSEHOOD
rows.clue: A false statement

rows.label: CHEWING OUT
rows.clue: A severe scolding

rows.label: SYMBOLISM
rows.clue: A system of symbols and symbolic representations

rows.label: LITERAL
rows.clue: A mistake in printed matter resulting from mechanical failures of some kind

rows.label: PRONUNCIATION
rows.clue: The manner in which someone utters a word

rows.label: ASSENTING
rows.clue: Agreeing with or consenting to (often unwillingly)

rows.label: SESSION COOKIE
rows.clue: A cookie that is stored temporarily and is destroyed when you close the link

rows.label: OBJECTIVE CASE
rows.clue: The case of nouns serving as the direct object of a verb

rows.label: BUGLE CALL
rows.clue: A signal broadcast by the sound of a bugle

rows.label: RECEPTION
rows.clue: The manner in which something is greeted

rows.label: DOWNBEAT
rows.clue: The first beat of a musical measure (as the conductor's arm moves downward)

rows.label: MENTION
rows.clue: A remark that calls attention to something or someone

rows.label: REHASH
rows.clue: Old material that is slightly reworked and used again

rows.label: VARIETY SHOW
rows.clue: A show consisting of a series of short unrelated performances

rows.label: EXCLAMATION
rows.clue: An abrupt excited utterance

rows.label: REVUE
rows.clue: A variety show with topical sketches and songs and dancing and comedians

rows.label: MINUTES
rows.clue: A written account of what transpired at a meeting

rows.label: PIANO SONATA
rows.clue: A sonata for piano

rows.label: LEGAL CODE
rows.clue: A code of laws adopted by a state or nation

rows.label: GOOD AFTERNOON
rows.clue: A conventional expression of greeting or farewell

rows.label: UNDERLINE
rows.clue: A line drawn underneath (especially under written matter)

rows.label: NEWS LEAK
rows.clue: Unauthorized (especially deliberate) disclosure of confidential information

rows.label: WEASEL WORD
rows.clue: An equivocal qualification

rows.label: BUSINESS CARD
rows.clue: A card on which are printed the person's name and business affiliation

rows.label: STORED PROGRAM
rows.clue: A program that is stored in the memory of the computer that executes it

rows.label: SALUTE
rows.clue: An act of honor or courteous recognition

rows.label: FOOTPRINT
rows.clue: A mark of a foot or shoe on a surface

rows.label: SHARP
rows.clue: A musical notation indicating one half step higher than the note named

rows.label: FINAL CUT
rows.clue: The final edited version of a movie as approved by the director and producer

rows.label: OVATION
rows.clue: Enthusiastic recognition (especially one accompanied by loud applause)

rows.label: DECREE
rows.clue: A legally binding command or decision entered on the court record (as if issued by a court or judge)

rows.label: FIRE ALARM
rows.clue: A shout or bell to warn that fire has broken out

rows.label: NOTEPAPER
rows.clue: Writing paper intended for writing short notes or letters

rows.label: MAJOR KEY
rows.clue: A key whose harmony is based on the major scale

rows.label: BROWSING
rows.clue: Reading superficially or at random

rows.label: BIRTHDAY CARD
rows.clue: A card expressing a birthday greeting

rows.label: GLASS CEILING
rows.clue: A ceiling based on attitudinal or organizational bias in the work force that prevents minorities and women from advancing to leadership positions

rows.label: DISSOLVE
rows.clue: (film) a gradual transition from one scene to the next

rows.label: ANECDOTE
rows.clue: Short account of an incident (especially a biographical one)

rows.label: VOWEL
rows.clue: A speech sound made with the vocal tract open

rows.label: SONATINA
rows.clue: A short and simple sonata

rows.label: WORKING PAPERS
rows.clue: Records kept of activities involved in carrying out a project

rows.label: PRONOUNCEMENT
rows.clue: An authoritative declaration

rows.label: ANTILOGARITHM
rows.clue: The number of which a given number is the logarithm
